A re-issued secondary IRC certificate reaches the races declared on it, and only those

A race declared on a boat's secondary certificate scores on the secondary the boat holds when the race is scored, not on the number written down when it was declared. A re-issued secondary therefore reaches every race declared on it; races on the primary are untouched.
